program:
PARAMS = {
    "Win":   (10.0, 3.0, 40.0),     # diff pair width [um]
    "Lin":   (0.5, 0.3, 1.0),       # diff pair length [um]
    "Wp":    (14.0, 4.0, 40.0),     # PMOS mirror-load width [um]
    "Lp":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),       # PMOS load length [um]
    "Wb":    (2.5, 1.0, 10.0),      # bias unit width (IREF diode), L=1
    "Itail": (45e-6, 25e-6, 70e-6), # OTA tail current (set by mirror ratio)
    "R":     (120e3, 40e3, 250e3),  # MFB resistor value (R1=R2=R3)
    "kf":    (1.0, 0.9, 1.1),       # fc trim
    "qa":    (1.0, 0.8, 1.25),      # Q trim, high-Q stage
    "qb":    (1.0, 0.8, 1.25),      # Q trim, low-Q stage
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    fc_t = 940e3 * p["kf"]
    wc = 2 * PI * fc_t
    R = p["R"]
    n = Netlist("vin vout vdd vss ibias")

    # bias: IREF diode + width-ratioed tail mirrors (same L)
    mt = max(1, int(round(p["Itail"] / iref)))
    Itail = mt * iref
    Lb = 1.0
    n.M("MB", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", "nfet", p["Wb"], Lb)

    # mid-rail reference for the OTA plus terminals
    n.R("RD1", "vdd", "vref", 1e6)
    n.R("RD2", "vref", "vss", 1e6)
    n.C("CD", "vref", "vss", 5e-12)

    # 5T OTA: gp = plus gate (diode side), gm_ = minus gate (output side)
    def ota(t, gp, gneg, out):
        n.M("MT" + t, "t" + t, "ibias", "vss", "vss", "nfet", p["Wb"] * mt, Lb)
        n.M("M1" + t, "d" + t, gp, "t" + t, "vss", "nfet", p["Win"], p["Lin"])
        n.M("M2" + t, out, gneg, "t" + t, "vss", "nfet", p["Win"], p["Lin"])
        n.M("MP1" + t, "d" + t, "d" + t, "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", p["Wp"], p["Lp"])
        n.M("MP2" + t, out, "d" + t, "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", p["Wp"], p["Lp"])

    # MFB biquad, equal R: w0=1/(R sqrt(C1C2)), Q=sqrt(C1/C2)/3
    def mfb(t, a_n, o_n, Q):
        C2 = 1.0 / (R * wc * 3.0 * Q)
        C1 = 3.0 * Q / (R * wc)
        x, m_ = "x" + t, "n" + t
        n.R("R1" + t, a_n, x, R)
        n.C("C1" + t, x, "vss", C1)
        n.R("R2" + t, x, o_n, R)
        n.R("R3" + t, x, m_, R)
        n.C("C2" + t, m_, o_n, C2)
        ota(t, "vref", m_, o_n)
        return C1, C2

    # first-order RC pole at the filter entry (low R0, light loading by R1)
    R0 = R / 40.0
    C0 = 1.0 / (wc * R0)
    n.R("R0", "vin", "p0", R0)
    n.C("C0", "p0", "vss", C0)

    # 5th-order Butterworth: Q = 1.618 and 0.618, real pole at wc
    mfb("A", "p0", "o1", 1.618 * p["qa"])
    mfb("B", "o1", "vout", 0.618 * p["qb"])

    # predictions
    A0 = 30.0
    try:
        op = lut.op("n", p["Win"], p["Lin"], 0.6, 0.45, 0.3)
        sc = (Itail / 2) / max(op["Id"], 1e-12)
        gm = op["gm"] * sc
        gds_n = op["gds"] * sc
        A0 = gm / (gds_n * 2.0 + 2.0 / R)
    except Exception:
        pass
    g = 1.0 / (1.0 + 3.0 / max(A0, 1.0))
    gain_db = 20 * math.log10(g * g)
    atten_db = 10 * math.log10(1 + 10.0 ** 10)
    power = 1.8 * (iref + 2 * Itail + 1.8 / 2e6)

    return n, {
        "fc": fc_t,
        "gain_db": gain_db,
        "peaking_db": 0.0,
        "atten_db": atten_db,
        "power": power,
    }

events.topology: 5th-order Butterworth: passive RC pole + two MFB biquads (Q=1.618, Q=0.618) on 5T NMOS-input OTAs
